metadata.scope: Draft 2020-12 schemas, synthetic invariants, target selection and static DDL evidence; no runtime/DB integration

cases.description: v2 example validates against Draft 2020-12 match schema
single physical target uses target_instance_id
multiple physical targets use unique target_instance_ids
duplicate target_instance_ids are rejected
legacy target_id is not accepted by the new target selector schema
single and multiple selector forms cannot be mixed
example satisfies global identity, zone, ownership and provenance invariants
same card_id is valid across distinct physical instances
example assigns globally distinct exemplar IDs to collection-backed instances
ordered zone arrays preserve list order
registry key and embedded instance_id must match
one physical instance cannot occur in two zones
registry entries cannot be orphaned from all zones
owner must match the participant whose zone contains the instance
a collection exemplar cannot be reused and must match owner/model
unknown exemplar IDs are rejected
generated token cannot claim collection provenance
instance card_id must match frozen definition snapshot
non-UUIDv4 instance IDs are rejected by schema
deck_exemplar requires positive exemplar_id
board rejects special/relic instances
owner approval record contains exactly the eight Group A decisions
current DDL supports global exemplar PK and owner/model validation
metric ties use persisted zone order then instance_id fallback
weakest metric selection follows the same deterministic tie rule
